editorial:
Imagine being a ten-year-old girl forced to move to a cold, scary military camp during a war. You are stuck with a mean stepfather who thinks he can control everything, and your only escape is a hidden world of magic. You follow Ofelia as she finds a strange labyrinth and meets a faun who tells her she is actually a princess. The vibe is a mix of a dark fairy tale and a gritty war movie, making you feel both the fear of the real world and the wonder of the fantasy one.

You will love the amazing creature designs and the strong acting, especially the scary villain. The story moves at a good pace and hits you hard with some emotional twists. While it can be a bit sad and violent in some parts, it is a beautiful ride. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the monsters. You could also rent it on Apple TV or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you love owning great movies.
endingExplained: In the end, the cruel captain kills Ofelia's baby brother and then shoots her. As she dies in the real world, she wakes up in a golden palace. The faun tells her that because she chose to save her brother instead of killing him, she passed the final test. She is reunited with her true parents as the princess of the underground kingdom, showing that her fantasy world was her way of escaping a cruel reality.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark fairy tales and emotional stories.
